ANTENNAL_LOBE.name: Antennal Lobe (AL)
ANTENNAL_LOBE.primaryFunction: Glomerular odor processing, bilateral contrast sharpening via local interneurons.
ANTENNAL_LOBE.scientificDescription: The primary olfactory center in the insect deutocerebrum. Possesses spherical microglomeruli where ORN axons synapse onto PNs and LNs.

MUSHROOM_BODY_CALYX.name: Mushroom Body Calyx (MB-CA)
MUSHROOM_BODY_CALYX.primaryFunction: Sensory convergence of PN olfactory axons onto Kenyon cell dendritic claws.
MUSHROOM_BODY_CALYX.scientificDescription: Dorsal neuropil receiving dense uniglomerular and multiglomerular projection neuron axons.

MUSHROOM_BODY_PEDUNCLE.name: Mushroom Body Peduncle (MB-PED)
MUSHROOM_BODY_PEDUNCLE.primaryFunction: Parallel axonal transmission of sparse Kenyon Cell population activity.
MUSHROOM_BODY_PEDUNCLE.scientificDescription: Fascicle of parallel Kenyon cell axons traversing anteriorly toward the vertical and medial lobes.

MUSHROOM_BODY_LOBES.name: Mushroom Body Output Lobes (MB-LOBES)
MUSHROOM_BODY_LOBES.primaryFunction: Associative memory readout (MBONs) modulated by Dopamine (punishment) and Octopamine (reward).
MUSHROOM_BODY_LOBES.scientificDescription: Divided into alpha/beta and gamma compartments where valence-specific MBONs and DANs/OANs intersect.

CENTRAL_COMPLEX_EB.name: Ellipsoid Body / Central Body Lower (CX-EB)
CENTRAL_COMPLEX_EB.primaryFunction: Internal celestial polarized light compass & 16-wedge angular heading ring attractor.
CENTRAL_COMPLEX_EB.scientificDescription: Toroidal/annular midline neuropil holding a persistent localized bump of neuronal activity encoding current heading orientation.

CENTRAL_COMPLEX_PB.name: Protocerebral Bridge (CX-PB)
CENTRAL_COMPLEX_PB.primaryFunction: Angular velocity integration and left/right optical flow calibration.
CENTRAL_COMPLEX_PB.scientificDescription: Handlebar-shaped dorsal midline neuropil computing directional steering differentials.

CENTRAL_COMPLEX_FB.name: Fan-Shaped Body / Central Body Upper (CX-FB)
CENTRAL_COMPLEX_FB.primaryFunction: Path integration accumulator (Odometer + Compass) storing Euclidean return home vectors.
CENTRAL_COMPLEX_FB.scientificDescription: Stratified modular neuropil maintaining translational step displacements relative to internal compass heading.

CENTRAL_COMPLEX_NO.name: Noduli (CX-NO)
CENTRAL_COMPLEX_NO.primaryFunction: Translational step odometer, mechanosensory stepping frequency input.
CENTRAL_COMPLEX_NO.scientificDescription: Paired ventral sub-neuropils encoding ground step frequency and optical flow speed.

LATERAL_ACCESSORY_LOBE.name: Lateral Accessory Lobe (LAL)
LATERAL_ACCESSORY_LOBE.primaryFunction: Premotor descending steering commands (flip-flop interneurons driving left/right motor bias).
LATERAL_ACCESSORY_LOBE.scientificDescription: Primary output hub of the Central Complex projecting descending commands to thoracic motor ganglia.

SUBESOPHAGEAL_ZONE.name: Subesophageal Zone (SEZ)
SUBESOPHAGEAL_ZONE.primaryFunction: Mandibular motor grasping, gustatory sugar/protein tasting, trophallaxis food exchange reflex.
SUBESOPHAGEAL_ZONE.scientificDescription: Ventral ganglion controlling mouthparts, mandibles, and labial glands.

OPTIC_LOBE.name: Optic Lobe (OL)
OPTIC_LOBE.primaryFunction: Visual obstacle avoidance, celestial polarized UV light detection, motion parallax.
OPTIC_LOBE.scientificDescription: Lamina, medulla, and lobula processing compound eye ommatidia inputs and dorsal rim area (DRA) polarization.

VENTRAL_NERVE_CORD.name: Ventral Nerve Cord (VNC)
VENTRAL_NERVE_CORD.primaryFunction: Ascending proprioceptive feedback and descending locomotor rhythm coordination.
VENTRAL_NERVE_CORD.scientificDescription: Paired axonal longitudinal connectives linking the subesophageal zone to the thoracic and abdominal ganglia.

PROTHORACIC_GANGLION.name: Prothoracic Ganglion (T1 Ganglion)
PROTHORACIC_GANGLION.primaryFunction: Front leg stepping, antennal grooming reflex, and tactile substrate probe.
PROTHORACIC_GANGLION.scientificDescription: Segmental ganglion controlling T1 anterior legs and anterior body posture.

MESOTHORACIC_GANGLION.name: Mesothoracic Ganglion (T2 Ganglion)
MESOTHORACIC_GANGLION.primaryFunction: Middle leg tripodal coordination, stance phase support, and cargo weight bearing.
MESOTHORACIC_GANGLION.scientificDescription: Segmental ganglion coordinating middle pair of walking legs during alternating tripod locomotion.

METATHORACIC_GANGLION.name: Metathoracic Ganglion (T3 Ganglion)
METATHORACIC_GANGLION.primaryFunction: Hind leg propulsion, bridging anchor gripping, and jumping/climbing thrust.
METATHORACIC_GANGLION.scientificDescription: Segmental ganglion powering rear propulsion and tarsal grip strength during living bridge attachments.

ABDOMINAL_GANGLIA.name: Abdominal & Gaster Ganglia
ABDOMINAL_GANGLIA.primaryFunction: Stridulatory organ vibration, Dufour trail pheromone gland deposition, and defensive posture.
ABDOMINAL_GANGLIA.scientificDescription: Posterior chain of ganglia controlling gaster flexion, sting/acidopore, and stridulatory plectrum rubs.
